pins.reference_platform: macOS arm64 CPU fp32, one Torch thread

implementation.proposal: Raw untempered sigmoid, typed head/tail queries, stable probability/start/end/index rank, head-major Cartesian products, stable product rank, exact-coordinate self exclusion; checkpoint defaults 32/32/64/0.2
implementation.graph: Encoder text states and concatenated head-then-tail relation query states; original learned endpoint/content/biaffine terms with dynamic L denominator
implementation.decode: Containing-mention canonicalization, insertion-preserving coordinate/semantic dedup, nearest occurrence, strict token-subset removal, stable final ordering; pinned full casefold/Python whitespace and codepoint metrics with public UTF8 bytes
implementation.pipeline: All relation methods, AutoPipeline forwarding and batching; one structures/entities/relations/classifications prompt; raw shared candidates before entity filtering; separate relation temperature/threshold; choice-prefix removal only at final mapping
implementation.unsupported: Negative-stride proposal logit views have no pinned Torch equivalent and return an explicit error

graph_validation.masked_policy: Exact positive-zero logits; public API requires valid routing/coordinates even for masked pairs
graph_validation.empty_policy: Positive B/L/R/P graph axes; empty relation/pair sets bypass native inference
graph_validation.parent_single_pair_trace_fix: Exporter assertion now checks only masked rows instead of assuming the last row is masked when P=1. P=1 re-export independently passed all nine real/dynamic comparisons with unchanged tolerances.

sigmoid_adjudication.bug: Stable negative sigmoid algebra changed a source f32 tie near -1.386, altering endpoint-cap and pair-cap selection
sigmoid_adjudication.decision: Fix local proposal arithmetic and source traversal; no tie exception, rounding bias, global confidence decoder change or tolerance relaxation
sigmoid_adjudication.parent_source_verification: Exact pinned git blobs for xexpf, constants, AArch64 FMA helper and license matched; operation order and f32 constants reviewed
sigmoid_adjudication.scope_limit: Bounded macOSarm64 Torch2.8 reference evidence, not arbitrary-platform scalar-libm identity. Harness layout classification is a Python mirror; actual Rust API layout/cap regressions are separate integration tests.
sigmoid_adjudication.license: Full SLEEF Boost1.0 license and Naoki Shibata/contributors/ARM notices retained

oracle_vectors.location: Ignored fixtures/gliner2.5-base-v1/relation-aux and relation-runtime-vectors subdirectories; no generated JSON added to corpus root or git
oracle_vectors.committed_subset: Pure proposal parity always exercises the committed relation_employment fixture; model-only non-full pipeline mode also uses that real oracle
oracle_vectors.strict_missing_fixture_probe: Missing decode vectors failed with exit101 as required

final_parity.non_confidence: Exact names/keys/shape/text/order/UTF8 bounds, including all task families in the independent mixed choice-prefix oracle

parent_gates.logs: Local m6-parent-{full-strict,no-model,msrv-full,release,clippy,tutorial6,v2-gate,sigmoid-validation} logs and JSON reports under the development work directory
